newsitem.title: FINLAND: STARCKJOHANN SEES PROFITS UP IN MAY-AUGUST.
newsitem.headline: STARCKJOHANN SEES PROFITS UP IN MAY-AUGUST.

text.p: Finnish hardware wholesaler and retailer Starckjohann said on Thursday it expected profits to improve clearly in May-August and that full-year 1997 net sales would grow.
"The group's net sales are seen growing this year and earnings are expected to improve clearly during the second tertial," Starckjohann said in a statement with its January-April results.
Starckjohann's four-month profit after financial items more than doubled to 14.5 million markka from 7.0 million in the year-ago period and its full-year 1996 profit was 77.4 million.
The group's full-year net sales were 3.1 billion markka.
